title: pteridium esculentum subsp. campestre
intro: Pteridium esculentum subsp. campestre, commonly known as the bracken fern, is a subspecies of the Pteridium esculentum plant, which belongs to the Dennstaedtiaceae family. The bracken fern is a perennial fern found in various parts of the world, particularly in temperate and subtropical regions. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Pteridium esculentum subsp. campestre include its use in treating various conditions, attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenoids.
